feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 30s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Two knobs on glass-still water, watching — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Colton says "Did it look at you? Before?" the man in his 40s says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Desta has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Anaconda Empress — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xavier mutters "So it bleeds." Ava says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Joseph has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Highbeam Deer — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desta asks "And you're still standing." Ava asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xavier mutters "And you're still standing." Desta breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Cheryl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Nino says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
💛 The Rebecca's Ring is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
💛 The Carpenter's square is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Tasting Spoon is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Seed packet is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.

🔥 The fire settles. Desta has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Choir Toad — I put it down today." "Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once." "It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Colton says "Did it look at you? Before?" Cheryl says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Cheryl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Dustboar — I put it down today." "It drops its head and paws the earth — once, twice — and the dust comes up in a wall. Tusks down. It is not going around you." "It swings its whole head sideways, tusks sweeping like scythes. The warts on its face are armor; the tusks are the argument." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ava says "So it bleeds." Desta mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Cheryl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Yuki says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Joseph says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Cheryl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nino says quietly "Say that again — slower." Yuki asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Colton has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Static — I put it down today." "It finds your voice in the static. It WEARS it. 'Help— help me—' in YOUR voice. Moving won't help once it has you." "It drops the voice. No static, no words — it RUSHES, no telegraph at all. Back off." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desta says "And you're still standing." Ava says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Desta has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Joseph says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Cheryl says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
